C-71-OUTLINE-OCCLUSION.Name: Hide the outline while a visible table intersects it
C-71-OUTLINE-OCCLUSION.Summary: After the separate table-centering repair, prevent the table of contents from covering table content without changing page geometry.
C-71-OUTLINE-OCCLUSION.ApprovalBasis: Owner clarification on 2026-10-19: hide the contents at any table/contents intersection during page scrolling, independently of hover. This supersedes the earlier proposed hover-only partial masking.

Goals.Goal: Hide the entire outline whenever any live table intersects its box inside the owning editor viewport, including initial layout, scrolling, resizing and table layout changes.
Restore the outline automatically when no table intersects it; retain its box so page and table geometry remain stable.

Constraints.Constraint: Use no hover condition, document/history/profile writes or whole-document observer. Hidden outline controls must not intercept pointer or keyboard input.
Scope observation to the owning editor and detach listeners, observers and scheduled work on unmount.
Separate protected commit, integration and CI; no version bump, tag or publication.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No partial clipping, per-item hiding, table resizing or new preference.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Both engines hide the whole outline on initial/scroll-induced table intersection and restore it after scrolling clear, with no pointer dependency, page shift or Markdown change.
Clipped-offscreen tables, narrow nonintersecting tables and other editor instances do not hide the outline. Resize, table changes and lifecycle cleanup are verified.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-011 outlineRail component and pure geometry helper; V-M-011 outline tests plus shared C-71 browser regression suite.
